title: Fix a pricing bug, then add coupons
prompt: Two jobs in this little shop repo. First, the tests in test/ fail because discounts are applied wrongly in src/pricing.js - fix it. Second, add applyCoupon(items, code, coupons) to src/cart.js: coupons is the array from data/coupons.json; a 'percent' coupon takes value% off the cart total and a 'fixed' one takes value dollars off, but only if the cart total (before the coupon) is at least min. Return the new total rounded to cents, never below 0. Throw an Error with the message 'invalid coupon' for an unknown code or one the cart doesn't qualify for.
